name: kalman_filter_trend_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: NIFTY's intraday trends are driven by institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithms executing directional mandates over 5–20 minute windows, creating persistent but noise-embedded price drift visible in 5-second bars. A Kalman filter with 2 states (price level + velocity) optimally separates genuine trend velocity from observation noise by dynamically adjusting its gain: when the index is in persistent directional flow, the velocity state converges to a stable non-zero value with low estimation uncertainty, yielding a high velocity/uncertainty ratio. When NIFTY's Kalman velocity/sigma exceeds 1.5 in one direction AND price sits above/below the Kalman level estimate AND agrees with session VWAP direction — institutional order flow is active and unexhausted. On NIFTY, these confirmed velocity regimes persist for 30–90 additional seconds, delivering 5–15 option premium points before the institutional batch exhausts and velocity reverts toward zero.

indicators.name: kf_level
indicators.formula: Kalman state[0]: estimated price level. F=[[1,1],[0,1]], H=[1,0], Q=diag([0.1, 0.001]), R=4.0, reset at each session open
indicators.purpose: Separates true NIFTY price level from 5-second bar noise. No fixed lookback — Kalman is recursive. Initialized at first bar of each day with high uncertainty (P[0,0]=100); needs ~120 bars (10 min) to converge, hence session start at 09:25. Q[0,0]=0.1 chosen so filter is responsive to genuine 5-second drifts (sqrt(0.1)~0.3 pts/bar true volatility expected in trending conditions); R=4.0 (±2 pts observation noise per 5s bar on NIFTY at 24000).

indicators.name: kf_velocity
indicators.formula: Kalman state[1]: estimated price velocity in points per 5-second bar
indicators.purpose: The directional signal. Positive = institutional buy flow; negative = sell flow. On NIFTY, institutional TWAP execution sustains a velocity of ±0.3–1.0 pts/bar (±4–12 pts/min) for 1–5 minute blocks. Q[1,1]=0.001 makes velocity a slowly evolving state — reflecting that institutional execution is persistent within a batch, not rapidly reversing bar-to-bar.

indicators.name: kf_uncertainty
indicators.formula: sqrt(P[0,0]) where P is the 2x2 Kalman covariance matrix
indicators.purpose: Estimation confidence. Low uncertainty after convergence (~120 bars) means the filter has locked onto a stable trend; high uncertainty means the filter is adapting to a regime change. Used in denominator of signal_strength to avoid trading while the filter reconverges after an abrupt NIFTY move (e.g., news spike).

indicators.name: kf_signal_strength
indicators.purpose: Velocity significance in sigma units — analogous to a t-statistic for the velocity state. Threshold of 1.5 filters out random walk (Brownian) noise while capturing genuine institutional drift. The threshold is scale-invariant: it measures signal-to-noise ratio in the Kalman's own uncertainty units, not raw points. Original strategy used 2.0 on 1-min bars; loosened slightly to 1.5 because 5s bars have more measurement noise per bar and a 2.0 threshold would over-filter.

indicators.name: session_vwap
indicators.formula: cumsum(close * volume) / cumsum(volume), reset at session open each day
indicators.purpose: Session directional bias filter. NIFTY above session VWAP = net institutional buying since open; below = net selling. Requires Kalman velocity to agree with VWAP direction — prevents trading against cumulative session flow. Not scaled: VWAP is always session-cumulative regardless of bar size.

indicators.name: velocity_consec
indicators.formula: Count of consecutive 5s bars where kf_velocity maintains same sign (reset when sign flips)
indicators.purpose: Trend persistence filter: requires 6 consecutive bars (30 seconds) of same-sign velocity before entry. Original used 5 consecutive 1-min bars (5 minutes) of directional confirmation. Compressed to 6 bars (30s) at 5-second resolution because at this frequency we trade the SUSTAINED phase of institutional momentum, not its full establishment — 30 seconds of consistent Kalman velocity is sufficient to confirm an active directional batch order is in flight, while longer windows would miss most of the subsequent 30–90 second move.

conditions: kf_signal_strength > signal_threshold (default 1.5: velocity is statistically significant)
close > kf_level (price above Kalman estimated level — momentum is leading the filter)
close > session_vwap (session net flow is bullish)
velocity_consec >= consec_bars (30 seconds of persistent upward velocity confirmed)
buy_ce.confirmation: All 5 conditions simultaneously true on the same 5s bar

conditions: close < kf_level (price below Kalman estimated level)
close < session_vwap (session net flow is bearish)
buy_pe.confirmation: All 5 conditions simultaneously true on the same 5s bar

exit.stop_rationale: If a Kalman-confirmed directional regime (velocity/sigma > 1.5, sustained 30s) reverses within 30 seconds, NIFTY has retraced ~8 spot points at ATM delta ~0.5 — a 4 pt option loss. An 8 spot point reversal from a Kalman-confirmed velocity state signals genuine regime change (institutional batch complete or opposing flow initiated), not temporary noise. Calibrated to the lower end of the 30-second typical NIFTY move (2–5 option pts) to exit before position decay compounds.
exit.target_rationale: Confirmed institutional momentum on NIFTY (Kalman velocity sustained 30s) typically continues for 60–90 more seconds, covering 15–20 spot points — 8 option pts at ATM delta ~0.5 captures ~50% of expected continuation before batch exhaustion. Consistent with 1-minute NIFTY move upper range of 3–7 pts; 8 pts targets the high end and captures the full continuation leg (1:2 risk-reward vs 4 pt stop).

filters.vix_filter: None applied in code — Kalman Q/R are fixed; the filter naturally widens uncertainty during volatile regimes, which reduces kf_signal_strength and suppresses entries organically
filters.time_filter: 09:25–15:20 IST; first 10 minutes excluded for Kalman covariance convergence (~120 bars)
filters.volume_filter: None — NIFTY index volume in 5-second bars is a synthetic aggregate of constituent volumes, not reliable for threshold filtering at this frequency
filters.trend_filter: session_vwap direction must agree with kf_velocity direction
filters.spread_filter: Not applicable — limit order execution at candle close

edge.edge_decay_risk: Low-Medium — Kalman state-space implementation requires noise parameter knowledge; the Q/R tuning is the moat. Risk: if institutional execution increasingly randomizes order flow (to avoid detection), velocity persistence shortens and the consec_bars filter will under-fire.

adaptation_notes: Original traded individual NIFTY 50 stocks using Kalman velocity aligned with NIFTY index direction. Converted to trade NIFTY index options directly, eliminating the stock-selection layer. Core Kalman math unchanged (same F, H matrices). Key changes: (1) Q and R noise parameters rescaled for 5-second bars — Q[0,0] reduced from 0.01 to 0.1 to allow level to track fast index moves, R reduced from 0.1 (1-min bar, large noise scaled) to 4.0 absolute points (5s bar observation noise ~±2 pts on NIFTY at 24000). (2) velocity_consec threshold compressed from 5 min (original: 5 consecutive 1-min bars) to 30s (6 consecutive 5-second bars) — we enter after velocity is established, not after full trend development. (3) NIFTY index direction filter (original: align stock trade with index KF_Velocity) replaced with session VWAP filter since we ARE trading the index. (4) Stops/targets converted from bps (25 bps entry = 60 pts on NIFTY at 24000) to option premium points (4 pts stop, 8 pts target at ATM delta 0.5).
weaknesses: Kalman assumes linear Gaussian dynamics — NIFTY gap opens or macro shock (Fed announcement, RBI surprise) cause step-jumps that temporarily destabilize the filter; kf_uncertainty spikes for 20–40 bars before reconverging, naturally suppressing entries but also blocking trades during the genuine post-shock trend

Q and R noise parameters fixed offline — low-volatility trending days have different signal-to-noise ratios than high-VIX volatile days; a single fixed R=4.0 may over-smooth on calm days (missing small persistent moves) and under-smooth on volatile days

30-second velocity persistence filter (consec_bars=6) means the strategy always enters 30s into an established move — misses the highest-velocity initial spike of institutional flow initiation; this is by design (reduces false positives) but limits alpha capture on fast news-driven moves
